FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sunnyvale Shopping Plaza is a premier shopping center located in a convenient area, featuring a diverse tenant mix of businesses such as boutique retail stores, professional offices, and service-oriented establishments. Our center is designed to provide an inviting atmosphere for customers, with high foot traffic driven by anchor tenants like pharmacies and coffee shops. We prioritize safety and have invested in up-to-date fire suppression systems, comprehensive security measures including surveillance cameras, and regular maintenance schedules to ensure the property is in top condition. Our commitment to compliance with local safety regulations, along with a clean claims history, enables us to create a secure environment for our tenants and visitors. With ample parking facilities and a community-oriented design, Sunnyvale Shopping Plaza stands out as a reliable destination for both shopping and leisure.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Sunnyvale Office Suites, LLC - An office space management company offering professional office solutions at a nearby location.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2022, water damage caused by a burst pipe resulted in damages amounting to $3,000. The claim has been resolved and the necessary repairs have been completed. Additionally, on 09/10/2023, minor vandalism was reported, incurring costs of $2,000. This incident is still under review, but proactive security measures have been implemented to prevent future occurrences.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class A safe, UL listed, rated for high-security operations
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Secured perimeter fencing with motion sensors and regular patrols by licensed security personnel during operating hours.
